samples.query_text: For a business traveler, compare four one-way flight options from Bengaluru (BLR) to Tokyo Haneda (HND) on 2026-06-18. Use this fixed offer data: Air India AI392 departs 01:20 AM, arrives 01:35 PM, duration 8h45m, non-stop, fare INR 42,800, carry-on included; Singapore Airlines SQ509/SQ632 departs 11:35 AM, arrives 08:10 AM next day, duration 17h05m, 1 stop SIN, fare INR 38,900, meal included; Thai Airways TG326/TG660 departs 00:30 AM, arrives 03:40 PM, duration 11h40m, 1 stop BKK, fare INR 41,200, checked bag included; Cathay Pacific CX624/CX542 departs 01:25 AM, arrives 12:45 PM, duration 8h50m, 1 stop HKG, fare INR 45,600, lounge eligible. Rank by best balance of duration, fare, and business convenience. Include action buttons for booking and fare alerts.

Create a compact outdoor-plan weather card for Seattle for Saturday 2026-05-16 using this fixed forecast: current 59 F, partly cloudy, feels like 57 F, humidity 68%, wind W 9 mph, UV 5, sunrise 5:29 AM, sunset 8:41 PM. Forecast periods: 8 AM 55 F partly cloudy 10% rain; 11 AM 61 F sun breaks 10% rain; 2 PM 66 F partly sunny 15% rain; 5 PM 64 F breezy 20% rain; 8 PM 58 F cloudy 30% rain. Recommend whether to schedule a picnic, walk, or museum visit. Include one weather source link.

Compare four mid-range Android phones for on-device AI note taking and camera use. Use this fixed data: Pixel 8a, USD 499, Tensor G3, 8 GB RAM, 128 GB storage, 64 MP camera, 7 years updates, AI call notes; Galaxy A56, USD 449, Exynos 1580, 8 GB RAM, 256 GB storage, 50 MP camera, 6 years updates, One UI AI tools; Nothing Phone 3a Pro, USD 459, Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, 12 GB RAM, 256 GB storage, 50 MP periscope, 3 years updates, clean UI; OnePlus 13R, USD 599, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, 12 GB RAM, 256 GB storage, 50 MP camera, 4 years updates, fast charging. Produce a decision matrix, top pick, and action buttons to compare prices.

Build a high-protein vegetarian dinner recipe for 2 people using pantry items: paneer 250 g, chickpeas 1 cup cooked, spinach 3 cups, Greek yogurt 1/2 cup, tomato puree 1 cup, basmati rice 1 cup, ginger garlic paste, garam masala, cumin, turmeric, lemon. Requirements: under 40 minutes, at least 30 g protein per serving, include ingredients with quantities, timed cooking steps, nutrition estimate, and two quick actions for grocery list and timer.

Turn this one-day GenAI developer summit schedule into a mobile agenda. Event date: 2026-07-09 at Bengaluru Convention Centre. Sessions: 09:00 Registration and breakfast, Hall Lobby, Host Ops Team; 10:00 Keynote Building On-Device Agents, Hall A, Speaker Maya Rao; 11:15 Workshop Compact UI IR for Mobile, Room 204, Speaker Anup K; 01:00 Lunch and demos, Expo Zone, Host Partners; 02:15 Panel Safe Declarative UI, Hall B, Speakers Chen Li and Sara Kim; 03:45 Lab Android OneUI Rendering, Room 204, Speaker DevRel Team; 05:00 Closing roadmap, Hall A, Speaker Maya Rao. Include save-to-calendar and venue-map actions.

Create an order tracking status UI for order GC-48291. Data: current status Out for delivery, ETA 2026-04-29 6:30 PM, carrier BlueDart, tracking BD99881244IN, delivery address Whitefield Bengaluru. Timeline: 2026-04-27 09:10 AM picked up from Mumbai hub; 2026-04-28 02:45 AM arrived Bengaluru sort center; 2026-04-28 08:20 AM dispatched to local facility; 2026-04-29 09:05 AM out for delivery. Include delivery instructions, contact courier action, and reschedule action.

Analyze this fictional cafe weekly sales data and create a dashboard-style answer. CSV: Item,Category,Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri; Espresso,Hot,42,39,45,44,51; Iced Latte,Cold,38,41,50,56,70; Masala Chai,Hot,55,58,60,62,65; Cold Brew,Cold,22,24,31,35,48; Sandwich,Food,30,28,33,36,44. Compute total sales by item, best day, weekday growth from Mon to Fri, category trend, and 3 operational recommendations.

Create a 2-day Kyoto itinerary for a couple visiting 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-19. Preferences: temples, food, calm walking routes, photography, budget JPY 40,000 excluding hotel. Must include day cards with times, places, estimated transport, costs, and action links. Candidate places: Fushimi Inari, Kiyomizu-dera, Nishiki Market, Gion, Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, Kinkaku-ji, Philosopher Path. Keep it realistic with morning/afternoon/evening blocks.

Diagnose Android battery drain for a Galaxy phone after a One UI update. Symptoms: battery dropped from 100% to 58% in 4 hours idle, device warm near camera, top battery users are Photos 18%, Play Services 11%, One UI Home 8%, Mobile Network 7%, screen time 28 minutes. Provide likely causes, a prioritized fix checklist, what to monitor for 24 hours, and support actions. Avoid factory reset unless everything else fails.

Compare three monthly saving options for a 30-year-old in India saving INR 25,000 per month for 5 years. Use assumptions: savings account 3.5% annual, fixed deposit 7.1% annual post-tax effective, balanced index fund 10% expected annual with market risk. Show estimated maturity amount, estimated gain, risk level, liquidity, and best fit. Include a disclaimer that this is educational, not financial advice, and add actions to open calculator and learn about risk.
